config.language: Display language. `auto` follows Kiro's display language (Chinese for Chinese, English otherwise). Command and setting names always follow Kiro's display language.
config.contextWindowTokens: Context window used to turn the server's context-usage percentage into tokens. Kiro does not store model windows locally; the default is 1,000,000.
config.creditPriceUsd: USD price per credit. `0` uses the overage rate from the quota API (currently $0.04).
config.importLegacySessions: Import and show sessions in the pre-1.0 Kiro format (no credits; tokens are rough estimates).
config.storage.mode: Where the local index is kept. Credits and tokens come from Kiro's own session files and are complete in both modes.
config.storage.mode.disk: Keep the index on disk. Latency and error history survives after Kiro deletes old logs.
config.storage.mode.memory: Keep statistics in memory only; nothing is written to disk or left behind. Rescans on every start; latency and error history only covers the logs Kiro still keeps.
config.storage.retentionDays: Days to keep latency and error records collected from Kiro logs. `0` keeps them forever. Credits and tokens are not affected.
config.statusBar.enabled: Show usage statistics in the status bar.
config.statusBar.mode: What to display in the status bar alongside the current session's context usage.
config.refreshIntervalSeconds: Seconds between scans of local data.
config.defaultRange: Default time range of the usage dashboard.
